---
title: "Wildfires.jl"
engine: julia
---

Wildfires.jl is a fire spread model built on
[Oceananigans.jl](https://github.com/CliMA/Oceananigans.jl) and
[Breeze.jl](https://github.com/NumericalEarth/Breeze.jl), targeting a coupled
fire–atmosphere model of the WRF-SFIRE kind. It is a ground-up rewrite; the
previous package lives in `archive/` and is documented there.

What exists today:

- **Georeferencing** — `ProjectedCRS` ties an Oceananigans grid in meters to a
  projected CRS (UTM by default); `raster_topography` turns a DEM raster into
  the terrain closure Breeze's `materialize_terrain!` takes.
- **Fire grid** — `fire_grid` refines an atmospheric grid's horizontal
  directions by an integer factor so fire cells nest exactly inside
  atmospheric cells.
- **Fire model** — `FireModel` holds the level set `φ` and ignition time
  `t_ignition`; `ignite!` places circular ignitions; `advance!` propagates
  the front with a prescribed rate of spread (Godunov upwind + Heun).

Every per-cell operation is a KernelAbstractions kernel launched through
Oceananigans, so the fire model runs on the CPU or a GPU. Design notes and
per-step progress are in `references/approach.md`.

## Installation

```julia
using Pkg
Pkg.add(url = "https://github.com/RallypointOne/Wildfires.jl")
```

## Example

```julia
using Wildfires, Oceananigans

atmosphere = RectilinearGrid(size = (8, 6, 4), x = (-960, 960), y = (-720, 720),
                             z = (0, 400), topology = (Bounded, Bounded, Bounded))
model = FireModel(fire_grid(atmosphere; refinement = 8))   # 64×48 cells at 30 m
ignite!(model, 0.0, 0.0; radius = 100.0)
for _ in 1:100
    advance!(model, 1.0; speed = 2.0)                       # m/s
end
```
